title: Old Friends
setting: a street with a lamp in the middle and a box on the right, both in the back layer.
shots: A green stick figure walks in from the left and a purple stick figure walks in from the right; they stop face to face near the lamp.
The purple figure walks to the box, the green figure follows a little behind and waves goodbye.
The purple figure turns to face the camera and waves too.
camera: show both figures the whole time, then zoom in a little at the end.
